title: Seat a root several workspaces declare as shared
summary: A path under a root several workspaces declare in composition.sources now resolves as shared (resolveSeat returns by: 'shared' with every declarer in declarers, and no seat) instead of seating at whichever declarer's identity sorts first. Mandate resolution reads every declarer's closure there and lets a mandate's authority.scope govern only when it names every declarer; ia position names the declarers; and ia preview and ia author accept an edit there when the repository's workspace is any declarer, so they no longer refuse it as IA-CLI-EDIT-UNOWNED. A shared repository root stays governed: ReadHandle.repositoryWorkspace and runtime's rootWorkspace keep the repository's workspace there, so ia validate, ia capture and the edit guard still refuse what its mandates refuse, a read that names no workspace reads every declarer's closure, and a default position composes each declarer. The edit guard applies a mandate scoped to every declarer whoever acts.
